title: Formal causes: debido a and a raíz de

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *debido a* and *a raíz de* from B1 Unit 6: they link a cause to a consequence, and they take a noun, never a verb (*debido a un error*). They suit the end of the military governments: what happened because of a crisis, a defeat or a vote.

sections.title: Cause connectors
rows: as a result of: *a raíz de la derrota*

items.spanish: Debido a la crisis económica de comienzos de los años ochenta, muchos gobiernos perdieron apoyo.
items.english: Because of the economic crisis of the early 1980s, many governments lost support.

items.spanish: A raíz de la derrota en la guerra de las Malvinas, los militares argentinos dejaron el poder en 1983.
items.english: As a result of the defeat in the Falklands/Malvinas war, the Argentine military left power in 1983.

items.spanish: A raíz del plebiscito de 1988, el régimen de Pinochet terminó en 1990.
items.english: As a result of the plebiscite of 1988, Pinochet's regime ended in 1990.

items.spanish: Los militares perdieron apoyo porque había una crisis económica.
items.english: The military lost support because there was an economic crisis.

sections.content: After *debido a* and *a raíz de* put a noun phrase (*la derrota*, *la crisis*). If you want a verb, use *porque* (*porque perdieron la guerra*). Do not drop the *a* or the *de*.
